sourceTitle: Immune Booster Beet, Carrot & Orange Juice
sourceText:
Immune Booster Beet, Carrot & Orange Juice
By: Julia
Published: Tuesday, May 17, 2016 - 11:46am

Ingredients




1 Beet, peeled
500g Carrots, peeled
1kg Oranges, peeled

Preparation

1 Roughly chop the beet, carrots and oranges. When peeling and chopping the beet, use gloves and apron to avoid staining your hands and clothes. 2 Throw them in a juicer and in about 2 minutes you will end up with this delicious healthy juice.

About

This immune booster beet, carrot & orange juice is not only great for boosting your immunity but also for detoxifying your liver and helping your body stay healthy!
